name: nodes
description: Use this skill when choosing the type of a node to place or plan, or when a task relies on what a built-in node does. It lists Curio's built-in templates, says how a node takes several connections on numbered input circles, and says what Data Loading, Python Computation, Data Summary, JS Computation, Data Export, Spatial Join, Simple View, Data Pool and Note nodes read, hold, show and hand on, such as the image columns a Simple View shows as cards.
